concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-manage-disbursements]] — 2026-09-15 Capital post-disbursement GET/PATCH guide for distinct grant/disbursement IDs, repayment basis-points configuration and region-limited unscheduled-repayment account details; examples are not funding proof.
warnings: This page assumes an existing disbursed grant and currently one disbursement per grant; it does not describe creating a new disbursement or prove one occurred.
fundsCollections account identification is for unscheduled repayment into Adyen, not grant payout to a user's bank; Europe/UK/US condition applies.
